title: agents.toml
description: How messages to an Agent are sent. Every key is optional.

enter.description:
What Enter does with a message written while the Agent works.
Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter on a Mac) does the other.

start.description:
What a new Thread on each Harness starts with, by the Harness's ID:
`[start.claude]`. The Agents section sets it from the composer's
bar.

workspaces.description:
Where an Agent's Thread opens: `"space"`, on its Space's workspace,
with the Space's other Agents; `"off"`, beside the Pane in front.

Enter.description:
Where a message written while the Agent works goes when sent with
Enter.

oneOf.description: Into the turn: the Agent reads it as it works, as in T3 Code.
Into the queue: it waits until the turn ends.

Start.description:
What a new Thread on a Harness starts with, over the Harness's own:
what it leaves out, the Harness chooses.

mode.description:
How freely its Agent acts: "supervised", "accept_edits", "auto" or
"full_access".

plan.description: The Agent makes a plan before it changes anything.

Mode.description:
How freely an Agent acts in a Thread (ADR 0003, decision 9). A Harness
that has modes of its own enforces the mode; for any other, the engine
answers the Harness's Questions by it.

oneOf.description: It asks before it changes anything.
It edits files without asking, and asks before anything else.
It decides itself what to ask about.

OptionValue.description: A value of one of the Harness's options: a choice's ID, or on or off.

Workspaces.description: Where an Agent's Thread opens (ADR 0065, decision 9).

oneOf.description: On its Space's workspace, in a row with the Space's other Agents.
Where the window has it: beside the Pane in front.
